recall.minute: Software engineering for ML treats the model as one part of a team-built system. The SDLC loop of planning, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance still applies, with roles such as business analysts, product owners, architects, developers and QA, and development has evolved from waterfall to agile, DevOps and cloud-native to AI-assisted ADLC. Data science adds data engineers (pipelines, warehouses), data scientists (exploration and models) and ML engineers (production, monitoring, retraining), and its hierarchy of needs runs collect, move/store, explore/transform, aggregate/label, learn/optimise, AI. ML differs from ordinary software in having three axes of change, code, data and model, and a model workflow of development, versioning, deployment, monitoring and retraining. ML has moved through three generations to pre-trained foundation models used through APIs, served as language, speech, vision and decision services, and built on by AI engineers. Because ML behaviour cannot be specified exactly, it is evaluated by accuracy rather than functional correctness.
